name: openloc
description: Translation management: projects, jobs, translation memory, terminology, QA and analytics from ChatGPT or Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Your translation projects, TMs, terminology and QA — in chat
interface.longDescription: OpenLoc is ModelFront's translation management system. Connect it to list and create projects, track job deadlines, search translation memories, manage terminology, read QA reports, and chart operational metrics like MT-engine usage or words processed per linguist — all with your organization's own data, scoped to what your account can see. Read-only or read-and-write access is chosen at connect time.
defaultPrompt: Use OpenLoc to list my overdue translation jobs.
Use OpenLoc to chart MT engine usage for German over the last 2 months.
Use OpenLoc to create a project for the new product launch, English into German and French.
